name: live-train-delay-tracker
description: High-performance, open-source real-time live train delay tracker across ConfirmTkt, MakeMyTrip, ClearTrip, Ixigo, Goibibo, and Paytm.
author: Rajdip Ghosh <https://github.com/RajdipGhosh99>

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npx tsx tests/e2e/playwright-suite.ts --headless
scripts.test:e2e:headful: npm run build && npx tsx tests/e2e/playwright-suite.ts
scripts.test:e2e:confirmtkt: npm run build && npx tsx tests/e2e/playwright-suite.ts --provider=confirmtkt
scripts.test:e2e:makemytrip: npm run build && npx tsx tests/e2e/playwright-suite.ts --provider=makemytrip
scripts.test:e2e:ixigo: npm run build && npx tsx tests/e2e/playwright-suite.ts --provider=ixigo
scripts.test:e2e:irctc: npm run build && npx tsx tests/e2e/playwright-suite.ts --provider=irctc
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run build && npx tsx tests/e2e/playwright-suite.ts --all
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run pack
